note: Regional park run by the Jean Louis Legare Regional Park Authority at Willow Bunch, set in dense trees in a Big Muddy Valley coulee, with a 9-hole golf course (licensed clubhouse). About half its sites are seasonal. Bring drinking water: the park's tap water is non-potable. A renter must be 18 or older. --Claude
